skill.summary: 将Hermes Agent的工作过程可视化 - 包括任务进度、技能使用、代码改动、会话统计等

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added bilingual documentation (Chinese and English) with comprehensive usage, configuration, and visualization instructions.
- Introduced detailed configuration options, including metrics selection, report frequency, output formats, and chart customization.
- Documented supported visualization types: task progress, skill usage, tool statistics, code tracking, and session summaries.
- Described automatic and manual language detection settings and supported language codes.
